question: Should OpenClaw accept this catalog as a core public CLI/plugin/prompt surface now, split it into narrower staged PRs, or keep it as an RFC/prototype until a maintainer sponsors the direction?
rationale: The PR intentionally adds user-facing commands, plugin descriptor fields, generated docs, report scripts, and agent prompt behavior, so code review cannot choose the permanent product/API boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split And Review Direction First
options.body: Keep the draft open but ask for a staged plan that separates the stable CLI read path from plugin API and prompt changes before merge.

options.title: Accept As Experimental Core Surface
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly sponsor the broad surface and require compatibility docs, conflict resolution, updated tests, and live behavior proof before landing.

options.title: Pause Or Close The Prototype
options.body: If this catalog is not wanted in core now, maintainers can pause or close the branch and keep discussion in the linked RFC until there is sponsorship.

recommendation.title: Split And Review Direction First
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open but ask for a staged plan that separates the stable CLI read path from plugin API and prompt changes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and merged PR metadata point to @pgondhi987 as the strongest available owner signal for the CLI/plugin/prompt surfaces this PR extends.
